project: Da Nang Smart Parking & Traffic Analytics - 7 day raw dataset
scope_note: Traffic sample focuses on the former Da Nang urban core/corridors; current whole-city population after 2025 merger is used only as a scale/context factor.
reported_parking_context: A 2023 Da Nang newspaper report stated about 24.8 ha of parking area, >11,000 parking positions, about 33% of planning demand to 2025. This is context only, not copied into event counts.

synthetic_model.weekend_behavior: lower CBD commute; higher coastal/tourist demand in afternoon/evening
synthetic_model.vehicle_mix_baseline: ~66% motorbike, ~27% car, remainder bus/truck with random variation
synthetic_model.data_quality_noise: ~1% null avg_speed, ~0.5% duplicate traffic rows; ~1.5% parking events without end_time and ~0.4% duplicates

sources.weather_reference: ChatGPT weather historical tool, Da Nang, 2026-08-05..2026-08-11

warning: Synthetic/approximate fields are for a personal Data Engineering portfolio. They must not be presented as measured city statistics or used directly for real policy decisions.
